responsibility: Defines the core data model the ARC backend uses to describe architectures and concrete CPU variants selected by -mcpu and related options. It builds the cpu_flags, base_architecture, tune, and extra-property enums from the ARC *.def tables, instantiates the arc_arch_t and arc_cpu_t lookup tables from arc-arches.def and arc-cpus.def, and exposes the current arc_selected_cpu handle that the rest of the backend consults for feature, tuning, and ABI-dependent decisions.
